items.title: Authors Guild Issues AI Guidelines for Publishers
items.excerpt: The Authors Guild released AI best-practice guidelines for publishers, with a top concern being the growing use of 'imperfect AI detectors' against authors; it follows the Guild's May guidance for authors and aims to ensure mutual trust.

history_match.title: Authors Guild Calls on Publishers to Share Anthropic Wealth

items.title: Is It or Isn't It? How Generative AI is Poisoning the Literary Well For Everyone
items.excerpt: After Vauhini Vara's Atlantic piece suggested the Caine Prize-winning story was probably AI-written, Lit Hub examines how detector-driven suspicion now shadows every writer and prize.

history_match.title: Caine Prize initiates ‘human-centred process’ after Zimbabwean winner accused of AI use

items.title: Why Are Publishers Suing Big Tech With One Hand and Embracing AI With the Other?
items.excerpt: Essay from an Authors Guild 'Whose Truth?' panel on authorship and AI, interrogating publishers who litigate against AI firms while adopting AI tools in-house.

items.title: About that Wired article on book publishers 'quietly' using AI
items.excerpt: Friedman unpacks WIRED's report on Big Five AI use; the under-the-radar detail is publishers saying far more authors use LLMs to write their books than is publicly reported.

history_match.title: Book Publishers Are Quietly Using More AI. Staff Are Revolting

items.title: PayAuthors.com: Are your books in pirate libraries?
items.excerpt: A new site and service lets authors check whether their books appear in pirate libraries of the kind used to train AI models.

items.title: Audible Will Launch New Features to Bring Listeners Into the Story
items.excerpt: Audible is rolling out AI-powered Character Guide, Interactive Stories (launched with Dracula) and Visual Explorer on multi-cast productions and Originals; 'AI is allowing us to create new interactive experiences,' says CPO Andy Tsao.

history_match.title: Audible's new features let you explore book worlds — and use AI to talk to characters

items.title: Google launched Expert Intelligence on Google Play Books
items.excerpt: Eligible Play Books e-books can now be added to Gemini Notebook as grounded sources to generate quizzes, infographics and Audio Overviews; 100,000+ titles from PRH, Macmillan, Bloomsbury and others. (Follow-up to the 08-28 Expert Intelligence launch — new Gemini Notebook integration.)

items.title: 출판인회의 "AI 기업, 학습에 이용한 책에 정당한 보상하라"
items.excerpt: 한국출판인회의가 '책이 없으면 AI도 없습니다' 호소문 연명을 시작했다. AI 학습은 권리자 이용 허락이 원칙이며, 학습 이용 작품·출처 기록 공개와 정당한 대가 지급을 요구했다.

items.title: [AI돋보기] AI 시대에 귀해진 '인간의 글'…헌책방 뒤지는 빅테크

items.title: AI로 만든 '딸깍 서적' 판치는 한국…저작권 보호는 '걸음마'
